title: Settings
subtitle: Gateway basics, performance, vector service, smart routing, content compliance and log shipping

siteName.label: Site name
siteName.extra: Shown on the login page, the sidebar and the browser title.

baseUrl.label: Base URL
baseUrl.extra: The public endpoint handed to clients. It must end with /v1, e.g. https://gateway.example.com/v1.
baseUrl.invalid: Must start with http:// or https:// and end with /v1

logRetentionDays.label: Log retention
logRetentionDays.extra: Days to keep call logs and audit logs in the local database (1–365). Older records are purged automatically.

protocolConversion.label: Protocol conversion
protocolConversion.extra: When enabled, requests are converted automatically if the client protocol differs from the upstream protocol (e.g. OpenAI Chat ↔ Anthropic Messages).
protocolConversion.warning: Protocol conversion is not lossless: special fields, tool calls, reasoning content and multimodal content may fail to convert.

performance.intro: These values take effect immediately after saving. Tune them according to your upstream account limits and server resources.

max_concurrency.label: Max concurrency
max_concurrency.extra: Global cap on requests processed at the same time; excess requests wait in the queue. 0 means unlimited.

queue_size.label: Queue size
queue_size.extra: Capacity of the waiting queue. New requests get 429 once the queue is full.

queue_timeout_sec.label: Queue wait timeout
queue_timeout_sec.extra: Maximum seconds a request may wait in the queue before receiving 429.

request_timeout_sec.label: Non-streaming request timeout
request_timeout_sec.extra: Maximum seconds from forwarding a non-streaming request until the full response arrives.

stream_idle_timeout_sec.label: Stream idle timeout
stream_idle_timeout_sec.extra: Maximum idle seconds allowed between two chunks of a streaming response; the connection is closed on timeout.

max_body_kb.label: Max request body
max_body_kb.extra: Upper limit of the accepted request body in KiB. Larger bodies get 413.

cooldown_sec.label: Cooldown
cooldown_sec.extra: Seconds an account stays in cooldown after a failure; no requests are assigned to it meanwhile.

max_retries.label: Max retries
max_retries.extra: How many other accounts to try after an upstream failure.

upstream_connect_timeout_sec.label: Upstream connect timeout
upstream_connect_timeout_sec.extra: Maximum seconds to establish the TCP/TLS connection with the upstream.

max_body_memory_mb.label: Request body memory budget
max_body_memory_mb.extra: Total request-body bytes the gateway keeps in memory at once; new requests wait, then get 503 on timeout.

vector_max_concurrency.label: Vector concurrency
vector_max_concurrency.extra: Concurrent embedding calls shared by smart routing and compliance.

vector_timeout_sec.label: Vector call timeout
vector_timeout_sec.extra: Timeout per embedding call; after it the compliance failure policy applies.

vector.notice: Smart routing and content compliance share this vector service. After changing the embedding model, rebuild all sample vectors.

account.label: Embedding account
account.extra: Only enabled embedding-type accounts can be selected.
account.empty: No embedding accounts available. Add and enable an embedding-type account in the account pool first.

model.label: Embedding model
model.extra: Upstream embedding model name, e.g. text-embedding-3-small.

smartRoute.applied: Saved. The change is live at runtime.

enabled.label: Enable smart routing
enabled.extra: When enabled, clients trigger automatic routing by requesting the virtual model name.

virtualModel.label: Virtual model name
virtualModel.extra: Requests for this model name trigger smart routing, e.g. yz-auto.

simpleGroup.label: Model group for simple requests
simpleGroup.extra: Requests classified as simple are routed to this model group.

complexGroup.label: Model group for complex requests
complexGroup.extra: Requests classified as complex are routed to this model group.

threshold.label: Classification threshold
threshold.extra: Requests whose similarity is below this threshold are treated as simple. Default 0.72.

confidenceGap.label: Confidence gap
confidenceGap.extra: When the gap between the top two confidences is below this value, the request is treated as simple. Default 0.

topK.label: Top K
topK.extra: Number of most similar samples that take part in the vote. Default 5.

ruleMaxChars.label: Rule max characters
ruleMaxChars.extra: When no sample matches, texts up to this many characters are treated as simple. Leave empty for the default.

contextComplex.label: Context complexity threshold
contextComplex.extra: Conversations with more messages than this are treated as complex directly. Leave empty for the default.

compliance.intro: Content compliance checks sensitive words and semantic samples before forwarding; a hit on a blocking policy group returns 403.

enabled.label: Enable content compliance
enabled.extra: When disabled, no sensitive-word or semantic checks are performed.

semanticThreshold.label: Semantic threshold
semanticThreshold.extra: An audit sample counts as a hit once its semantic similarity reaches this value. Default 0.85.

checkSystemPrompt.label: Check system prompt
checkSystemPrompt.extra: Also inspect the content of the system prompt.

onFailure.label: When the check dependency fails
onFailure.extra: What to do when the vector service times out or is unavailable and the semantic check cannot run; keyword matching always applies.
onFailure.hint: Either way the degradation is counted in metrics and written to the audit log as "degraded" (at most once per 10 s) so a long outage is visible.

es.notice: Only Elasticsearch 9.x is supported. When enabled, call logs are shipped asynchronously; the local queue drops entries by capacity when writes fail.
es.secretExtra: Leave empty or keep ****** to leave it unchanged.

enabled.label: Enable shipping
enabled.extra: When enabled, call logs are written to Elasticsearch asynchronously.

authType.label: Authentication
authType.extra: Choose API Key or Basic Auth according to your Elasticsearch security setup.

indexPrefix.label: Index prefix
indexPrefix.extra: Prefix of the target index name; indices roll over daily, e.g. yzapi-2026.09.08.

requestKb.label: Request body limit
requestKb.extra: Maximum KiB of request body to store; longer bodies are truncated. 0 stores no body.

responseKb.label: Response body limit
responseKb.extra: Maximum KiB of response body to store; longer bodies are truncated. 0 stores no body.

retentionDays.label: External retention
retentionDays.extra: Days to keep log indices in Elasticsearch; expired indices are deleted automatically. 0 disables cleanup.

pricing.notice: Built-in prices are reference values checked in {{date}} (per 1M tokens). Providers change prices at any time: verify against their price pages and edit as needed. Models without a price are marked unpriced and excluded from cost.
pricing.patternExtra: Exact model name, or a prefix (gpt-5 matches gpt-5-2026-03-01 but not gpt-5-mini, which has its own row); longest wins
pricing.cachedExtra: Price of prompt tokens served from the prompt cache
pricing.cacheWriteExtra: Anthropic only; not metered separately yet, billed at input price
pricing.unitHint: Reports convert to the base currency
pricing.resetConfirm: Restore every built-in row to the reference value and drop retired built-ins; custom rows are kept. Continue?

currency.label: Base currency
currency.extra: Reports and logs show all costs in this currency

rate.label: USD → CNY rate
rate.extra: Used when a row's currency differs from the base currency
